title: Visual Perceptual Learning for the Treatment of Visual Field Defect
brief_summary: This study will test the hypothesis whether visual field defect caused by chronic stroke could be improved by visual perceptual learning. The secondary hypothesis is that improvement of visual field defect would be accompanied by connectivity changes in visual networks. In addition, investigators will evaluate whether improvement of visual field defect could achieve improvement of subjective visual function.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. The patient has chronic stroke more than 6 months after onset.
2. The patient has visual field defect (Quadrantanopia or Hemianopia).
3. The patient has corrected eyesight 0.7 or above.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. The patient has contraindication to MRI scan.
2. The patient has cognitive impairment (Mini-Mental Status Exam score \<24).
3. The patient has ophthalmologic diseases (e.g., glaucoma, cataract).
